2607.07282.title: A Word-Level Digital Reader of the Prasthanatrayi with Sankara's Bhasya: Corpus, Method, and an Open, Offline Reading Aid for the Advaita Vedanta Canon
2607.07282.paper_summary: The Prasthanatrayi -- the ten principal Upanisads, the Brahmasutra, and the Bhagavadgita, with Sankara's commentaries (bhasya) -- is the foundational corpus of Advaita Vedanta. Continuous euphonic combination (sandhi), long compounds (samasa), and dense scholastic prose make it hard to read at the word level: where one word ends, and what each word means grammatically, are both obscured. We present an open, fully offline, word-level digital reader of the entire Prasthanatrayi with Sankara's bhasya. Every word -- of both the root text (mula) and the commentary -- is clickable and resolves to a pop-up giving its split (padaccheda), morphological analysis, and gloss. Because every word carries a lemma, the reader also acts as a concordance: a search on a dictionary headword retrieves all of that word's inflected and sandhi-hidden occurrences, and its occurrences inside compounds, across both layers. The resource covers thirteen commentarial units (2,971 verses, sutras, and prose sections; 36,881 analysed word-occurrences of root text) and a global dictionary of 95,587 distinct commentarial surface forms. We describe the corpus, the hybrid pipeline -- a rule-based sandhi splitter over an inflected-form lexicon and attested-corpus look-ups, with LLM-assisted analysis under an adversarial two-pass verification protocol -- and a durable human-review loop whose corrections survive every regeneration. An intrinsic evaluation against independent Sanskrit resources finds high-confidence analyses agree with an authoritative inflectional lexicon on over 99% of attested forms, and a band-blind adjudication confirms that quality degrades predictably across confidence bands, with errors concentrated in the low-confidence tier the review loop targets. The reader is a single self-contained HTML file needing no server or network, offered as a freely redistributable teaching and reading aid.
2607.07282.paper_summary_zh: 普拉斯坦那特拉伊——十部主要的奧義書、梵文經典和《薄伽梵歌》，以及商羯羅的注釋（bhasya）——是非二元唯識的基礎文獻。持續的音韻結合（sandhi）、長複合詞（samasa）和密集的學術散文使得在字詞層面上閱讀變得困難：一個詞的結束位置以及每個詞在語法上的意義都變得模糊。我們提供了一個開放的、完全離線的、字詞層級的數位閱讀器，涵蓋整個普拉斯坦那特拉伊及其商羯羅的bhasya。每個詞——無論是根文本（mula）還是注釋——都是可點擊的，並會彈出一個窗口，顯示其分解（padaccheda）、形態分析和釋義。因為每個詞都有一個詞條，這個閱讀器同時也充當了一個索引：在字典的主詞上進行搜索可以檢索到該詞的所有變化形式和隱藏在音韻結合中的出現，還有它在複合詞中的出現，涵蓋了兩個層面。該資源涵蓋了十三個注釋單元（2,971 篇詩句、經文和散文部分；36,881 個根文本的分析詞出現）和一個包含 95,587 種不同注釋表面形式的全球字典。我們描述了這個語料庫、混合管道——基於規則的音韻分割器，利用變化形式詞典和經典語料庫查詢，並在對抗性的雙重驗證協議下進行 LLM 輔助分析——以及一個持久的人類審查循環，其修正能夠在每次再生中保留。對獨立的梵文資源的內部評估發現，高置信度的分析與權威的變化詞典在超過 99% 的已證實形式上達成一致，而盲審裁定確認質量在置信度範圍內可預測地下降，錯誤集中在審查循環所針對的低置信度層級。該閱讀器是一個獨立的 HTML 文件，無需伺服器或網絡，作為免費可再分發的教學和閱讀輔助工具提供。
2607.07282.author: Tamal Maharaj et.al.
